meta.title: The bulk counter-offer note is silently dropped
gaps: The case requires two active bids; the fixed prepared event has only one and cannot be expanded.
Changing a bulk counter-offer price, entering a note and sending it cannot be reached while Send Bulk Counter Offer is disabled.
No catalog step opens vendor-side counter-offer details to assert that every vendor sees the note or that creator_counter_offer_remarks is empty.
The raise_bulk_counter_offer request cannot be triggered in this prepared state, so its missing remarks field cannot be checked with expect_request.
